name: communication-services
description: Email, SMS, chat, and voice communication capabilities

roleAssignments.note: Communication Services doesn't have a dedicated data-plane RBAC role yet; Contributor on the resource is needed for send operations

defaultConfig.note: Communication Services is a global resource. Email uses Azure-managed domains (auto-verified) or custom domains (requires DNS verification).

integration.authNote: Use DefaultAzureCredential with Communication Services endpoint. Assign Contributor role on the Communication Services resource to the managed identity.

appSettings.name: AZURE_EMAIL_SENDER
appSettings.description: Sender email address from Azure-managed domain (e.g., DoNotReply@xxxxxxxx.azurecomm.net)

sdkInitPattern.python:
from azure.communication.email import EmailClient
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

credential = DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'))
email_client = EmailClient(os.environ['AZURE_COMMUNICATION_ENDPOINT'], credential)

# Send email
message = {
    'senderAddress': os.environ['AZURE_EMAIL_SENDER'],
    'recipients': {'to': [{'address': recipient, 'displayName': name}]},
    'content': {'subject': subject, 'plainText': body}
}
poller = email_client.begin_send(message)
result = poller.result()
